candidates.description: risk-off switch (Sahm-like gap >= 0.5 p.p. only): point = BVAR_MINNESOTA point, quantiles = ENSEMBLE_INVERSE_MSE quantiles shifted by (BVAR point - inverse-MSE point), i.e. inverse-MSE shape with BVAR location; inverse-MSE ensemble otherwise
candidates.motivation: v1 (ENSEMBLE_REGIME) fixed the C4 RMSE in recessions (0.9734/0.9035) but failed C4 CRPS (1.0019/1.0133) and C1 W2 (0.9705); v2 (ENSEMBLE_REGIME_V2) recovered C1/C2 but lost C4 RMSE on W1_EXT (1.0277) and still failed C4 CRPS on W2 (1.0019). The two published diagnostics say that BVAR_MINNESOTA gives the better location in recession months and the inverse-MSE distribution gives the better shape, so v3 combines location from the first with shape from the second for the risk-off months
candidates.design_disclosure: The choice of BVAR_MINNESOTA as the risk-off location and of ENSEMBLE_INVERSE_MSE as the shape is POST-DIAGNOSTIC: it is derived from the C4 diagnostic in the v5 protocol chain and from the published v1/v2 results (docs/112, docs/115), not fixed independently of those outcomes. This is a disclosed researcher degree and it is exactly why v3 is registered as a new candidate instead of changing any criterion. v3 is NOT a re-score of v1 or v2 and does not retract their reports; both remain published with their original numbers. The flag (Sahm-like 3m UNRATE gap >= 0.5 p.p., origin data only), the target/horizon and the evaluation criteria are unchanged; no weight, member, threshold or mapping was tuned against the v3 evaluation result, and the composition rule was fixed before the run. The point/quantile grid are deliberately not forced to share a median: the point is a member average, the grid is a mixture quantile grid, and the location anchor is the BVAR point.
candidates.note: registered before its own evaluation; evaluation report protocols/regime_v3_candidate_evaluation_report.json; v1 and v2 remain published and are not re-scored
